scope: offline advisory-intake evidence for kernel profile-facing vendored, firmware, and profile-slot TCB components

policy.release_rule: A security advisory affecting a retained, built, or exposed subset is a release blocker until re-vendored or waived.
policy.non_goal: This manifest is a deterministic local gate. It does not perform live network CVE ingestion and does not close production-kernel supply-chain risk by itself.

components.retained_subset_policy: Assess only retained BearSSL crypto/TLS sources and the freestanding shim listed in third_party/bearssl/README.vendored.md. Advisories for unvendored tools, examples, or unused protocol features require a documented not-applicable waiver.
release_blocker_if: the advisory affects retained crypto, TLS parsing, hashing, entropy, or constant-time primitives
the advisory affects local freestanding shim behavior
the affected upstream range cannot be compared with revision 7bea48e5e850ab4cafbe68d3765cdaba13a86d6f

components.retained_subset_policy: Assess the retained QuickJS-NG engine and local quickjs.h build flags documented in third_party/quickjs/README.vendored.md. Advisories limited to omitted examples, tooling, or disabled optional modules require a retained-subset waiver.
release_blocker_if: the advisory affects bytecode parsing, JS parsing, runtime isolation, allocator behavior, or host callback boundaries used by confined agents
the advisory affects BUILDING_QJS_SHARED or QUICKJS_NG_MODULE_BUILD local configuration
the affected upstream range cannot be compared with version 0.15.1 / revision fd0a0210b7be00957751871e7e01b8291268fc29

components.retained_subset_policy: Assess the retained WAMR interpreter/runtime subset and the local mc platform port documented in third_party/wamr/README.vendored.md. Advisories limited to omitted embedders, examples, or unused build modes require a retained-subset waiver.
release_blocker_if: the advisory affects WASM validation, interpreter execution, sandbox memory access, host calls, or allocator integration used by confined agents
the advisory affects core/shared/platform/mc local integration
the affected upstream range cannot be compared with version 2.4.3 / revision 0e65961d8e560b3d8a125045a29336ce6a0b16ad

components.retained_subset_policy: Assess the retained freestanding libm subset and build integration documented in third_party/openlibm/README.vendored.md. Because the retained tree records a comparison commit rather than a uniquely provable upstream version, release waivers must explicitly account for that provenance limit.
release_blocker_if: the advisory affects retained math routines used by confined C apps, QuickJS, or WAMR hosts
the advisory affects build integration that changes runtime object contents
the affected upstream range cannot be compared with retained-subset comparison commit b8b7bec46076bbe5fee43ffe8f9b2a4c8352a9c8

components.retained_subset_policy: Assess the OpenSBI firmware image selected by the kernel-qemu or production-kernel platform profile. Environment-provided firmware is not production-admitted until the exact platform image, version, build source, and advisory review are recorded by that profile.
release_blocker_if: the advisory affects SBI calls, privilege transitions, trap delegation, firmware memory protection, or boot handoff used by the kernel profile
the selected platform image cannot be mapped to a reviewed OpenSBI release, tag, commit, or vendor firmware bulletin
the firmware image differs from the reviewed platform image

advisory_sources.name: RISC-V OpenSBI advisories for firmware stacks using OpenSBI
NVD keyword search for RISC-V firmware

components.retained_subset_policy: No real production board firmware is admitted yet. Before production, the selected board firmware, DTB, boot ROM assumptions, vendor advisory feed, image digest, and update policy must replace this placeholder with concrete platform metadata.
release_blocker_if: a production-kernel profile selects board firmware without exact image identity, vendor/source provenance, and advisory feed
the board firmware advisory feed reports an unwaived issue affecting boot, SBI, memory protection, device tree, storage, network, DMA, or interrupt behavior
the selected board image cannot be reproduced or matched to the reviewed profile metadata

advisory_sources.name: NVD keyword search for confined runtime candidates

components.retained_subset_policy: No single production Agent runtime is admitted yet. Before production, this profile slot must resolve to a concrete runtime component with exact revision, retained subset, sandbox boundary, advisory intake row, and release waiver policy.
release_blocker_if: production-kernel selects a runtime without exact component identity, retained-subset policy, and advisory source coverage
the selected runtime has an unwaived advisory affecting parsing, execution isolation, host calls, allocator behavior, or sandbox memory access
the runtime profile depends on vendored code not listed in docs/tcb-components.json
